samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GTM + partners. Two asks from AEs: 1) how to tag inbound trials in SFDC, 2) exact partner pilot terms and where to register.
samir: Also need a 1-line pitch for sequences and a very short Hosted vs Dedicated decision note for SDRs.
lucy: Trials = POC until a signed PO or active subscription. Please do not include POCs in commit. Add expected-close on the POC record.
lucy: Partner pilot: registered partners only; 10% co-sell credit for Q2 pilot; credits applied on invoice; no retro credits. Registration form in #partners (link in channel).
dante: I'll draft a 2-sentence partner outreach line and post in this thread by EOD.
rachel: Product will publish a one-pager decision tree (Hosted->Dedicated signals) and a one-line AE pitch by tomorrow.
partner-ops-bot: Partner registration form -> https://redwood.co/partners/register
samir: Action items recap: 1) Lucy: SFDC POC field + pilot rules doc; 2) Dante: partner pitch; 3) Rachel/Product: Hosted vs Dedicated one-pager. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
dante: :white_check_mark: pitch posted.
lucy: :white_check_mark: POC field added and pilot doc published.
rachel: :white_check_mark: one-pager posted to /docs/internal and linked in #sales.
samir: Thanks all, closing thread. :v:
